name: Asset tax base
expression: Future tax deduction associated with asset recovery
meaning: A source-supported LM9 tax measurement or analytical relationship.
intuition: Connects reported tax amounts, tax bases, future reversals, or rate disclosures.
workedExample: See the corresponding original LM9 worked example.
commonMistake: Confusing permanent with temporary differences or tax expense with cash taxes.
relatedLearningOutcome: contrast accounting profit, taxable income, taxes payable, and income tax expense and temporary versus permanent differences between accounting profit and taxable income
